Make the SVG element wrapper independent of transitive integer declarations.

facts.statement: All 14 audited Recoil owned headers that directly include RmlUi now directly include cstdint first. The set spans backend, component, SVG, SolLua binding, and SolLua plugin wrappers.

Build 4 is reported FAILED in exactly three target translation units: RmlUi_VFSFileInterface.cpp, ElementSVG.cpp, and ElementLuaTexture.cpp. The exact 25 target command audit also found RmlSolLua.cpp as a latent instance before this broadened repair.

The accepted source report, SHA-256 ccbb442d020d493e711830f119f62a65c78db289ec418fe1c48e42a2ccac0b0c, reports PASS for all 25 Rml target translation units replayed from the exact failed target commands with successor includes and syntax-only compilation.
The Recoil source wire identity bytes encode 424152432d4652312d5245434f494c2d41544f4d49432d56312d303737463942, the wire portion of the newly frozen canonical factory identity.

Root freezes canonical identity barc-factory-atomic-v1|25f6d81|BARC-01.5-fr5-peer-observer-v1 Headless|424152432d4652312d5245434f494c2d41544f4d49432d56312d303737463942. The audited HighBar runtime qualification header and FSBar allowlist still carry the earlier 8a identity, so successor product, custody, and allowlist sources are required before admission.

No full build of 25f6 is established by the syntax probes. Build 5 is compile-only and nonadmissible even if its CTests pass; native observations remain 0 of 6, and no game, two-peer, callback, refund, or runtime-ready result is established.
